company.name: Worklife
company.shortDescription: Worklife is a web and mobile app that helps teams run highly productive, engaging meetings.
company.description:
WorkLife is a web app that helps teams have more productive meetings. It is a collaboration platform that automates best practices for managing meetings, projects and people and helps team to improve their performance by using it. It helps to create agendas, stay on track during the meeting, and ensure next steps will be done afterwards.

WorkLife is founded in 2014 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
